name: snaplii-a2m-payment
description: Shop and save with Snaplii, a separate, pre-funded account with user-controlled permissions and spending limits. AI agents buy gift cards across 500+ brands in Canada and the US with vouchers and up to 10% cashback, check the Snaplii Cash balance, pay bills (Canada only) and send P2P transfers, without seeing the user's card or bank credentials.

SNAPLII_API_KEY.title: Snaplii API key
SNAPLII_API_KEY.description: Optional. The key from the Snaplii app (More → Payment Methods → AI Payment Management → + New API Key). When set, the agent connects with it directly. Leave empty to type the key into the secure card when the agent connects.
